question: Which Union Minister announced Rajasthan as host of Khelo India University Games 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anurag Thakur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Anurag Thakur, the Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports, announced that Rajasthan will host the **Khelo India University Games (KIUG) 2025**.
 
• The Khelo India University Games is part of the **Khelo India initiative**, which aims to promote sports culture and identify young talent across India.
 
• Rajasthan was chosen as the host due to its focus on sports infrastructure development and its commitment to fostering sports participation at the grassroots level.
 
• The Khelo India University Games is one of the largest university-level sporting events in India, featuring athletes from various universities competing in multiple disciplines.
 
• Anurag Thakur has been actively involved in promoting sports in India, launching initiatives to improve infrastructure and provide opportunities for athletes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mansukh Mandaviya**

 
 
• Mansukh Mandaviya is the Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare.
 
• He is responsible for overseeing key initiatives like Ayushman Bharat, National Health Mission, and COVID-19 vaccination efforts.
 
• Mandaviya has played a pivotal role in improving healthcare infrastructure in India and ensuring equitable healthcare access.
 
 
 
• **Kiren Rijiju**
 
 
• Kiren Rijiju served as the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports before Anurag Thakur took over the portfolio.
 
• He is currently the Union Minister of Earth Sciences and has contributed to initiatives like Fit India Movement and Khelo India.
 
• Under his tenure, the government focused on promoting fitness and identifying sports talent across India.
 
 
 
• **Nitin Gadkari**
 
 
• Nitin Gadkari is the Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways.
 
• He is known for his contributions to infrastructure development, including highways, expressways, and green energy initiatives.
 
• Gadkari has played a significant role in promoting sustainable transport systems and smart infrastructure in India.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India Initiative**
 
 
• The Khelo India program was launched in 2018 to promote sports and fitness across India.
 
• It encompasses events like Khelo India Youth Games, University Games, and Winter Games.
 
• The initiative focuses on identifying and nurturing sports talent, creating sports infrastructure, and encouraging participation among the youth.
 
• It aims to build a strong sports ecosystem and position India as a global leader in sports.
